title: Enhancing Shrimp Disease Detection via Deep Learning and Data Refinement for Resilient Aquaculture
abstract: arXiv:2609.23397v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Shrimp diseases continue to cause devastating losses in the aquaculture industry, driving a critical need for robust, automated detection. This work contributes the first application of Vision Transformers (ViT) and Self-Supervised Learning (SSL) to the shrimp farming domain, addressing both performance bottlenecks and data labeling challenges. We propose two deep learning pipelines to classify four key diseases: Healthy, Black Gill (BG), White Spot Syndrome Virus (WSSV), and a co-infection of both using a dataset of 4,348 images. First, our supervised transfer-learning approach leverages ImageNet-pretrained ViT-Small/16 and EfficientNet backbones. Second, we introduce a contrastive learning framework (SimCLR) with a ViT-Small encoder to extract robust representations from unlabeled images prior to fine-tuning. translated_title: 通过深度学习与数据精炼增强对虾病害检测，构建韧性水产养殖业
translated_abstract: 对虾病害持续给水产养殖业造成毁灭性损失，因此迫切需要稳健的自动化检测方法。这项工作首次将视觉Transformer（ViT）和自监督学习（SSL）应用于对虾养殖领域，同时解决了性能瓶颈和数据标注两大挑战。我们提出了两种深度学习流程，基于包含4,348张图像的数据集对四种关键状态进行分类：健康、黑鳃病（BG）、白斑综合征病毒（WSSV）以及两者的合并感染。第一种是我们的有监督迁移学习方法，利用在ImageNet上预训练的ViT-Small/16和EfficientNet骨干网络；第二种是我们引入的对比学习框架（SimCLR），采用ViT-Small编码器，在微调之前从无标签图像中提取鲁棒的特征表示。我们的结果为可持续水产养殖监测建立了强有力的新基线。有监督方法取得了出色……（原文摘要此处截断）
tldr: 该论文首次将视觉Transformer（ViT）与自监督学习（SSL）引入对虾养殖领域，提出了基于有监督迁移学习和SimCLR对比学习的两种深度学习流程，可利用4,348张图像对健康、黑鳃病、白斑综合征病毒及合并感染四种状态进行分类，为可持续水产养殖监测建立了新的性能基线。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first application of Vision Transformers and Self-Supervised Learning to the shrimp farming domain, proposing two deep learning pipelines (supervised transfer learning and SimCLR-based contrastive learning) that classify four disease states from 4,348 images and establish strong new baselines for resilient, sustainable aquaculture monitoring.
